title: Asset Pricing Under Endogenous Expectations in an Artificial Stock Market
implementation: Conditional affine forecasts, lagged squared-error learning, inverse-error selection, crossover and mutation
deviation: Price returns instead of price plus dividends; six predictors, bounded quantities, no CARA equilibrium clearing

title: Reaching a Consensus
implementation: Synchronous row-stochastic opinion pooling on a fixed ring
deviation: Private-information anchoring is an AFS extension; this extension need not converge to consensus

title: Advances in Prospect Theory: Cumulative Representation of Uncertainty
implementation: Reference-dependent value, loss aversion and cumulative decision weights for two outcomes
deviation: Average entry price as reference and a two-outcome next-quote scenario are AFS assumptions; no Taiwan calibration

title: Allocative Efficiency of Markets with Zero-Intelligence Traders: Market as a Partial Substitute for Individual Rationality
implementation: Random side, quantity and limit subject to private valuation/cost and cash/inventory constraints
deviation: Repeated stock inventory with a market maker, not the paper's single-unit continuous double auction; no allocative-efficiency claim

title: When AI Meets Finance (StockAgent): Large Language Model-based Stock Trading in Simulated Real-world Environments
implementation: Four investor profiles, per-agent news memory, partial observations and action validation
deviation: Offline numerical policies; no LLM, text comprehension, loans or BBS natural-language conversations

title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
implementation: Structured fundamental/technical/news reports, bull/bear summaries, trader aggregation and exposure/drawdown risk gates
deviation: Offline numerical role decomposition; no actual LLM debate, external research tools or reproduction of reported returns
